full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the appellant submitted that in view of the suit being one for specific performance of contract, the High Court Division erred in law in remanding the suit to the lower appellate Court in order to enable the respondent to file an 'application for partition, if any, and dispose of the same in accordance with law, being outside the scope of suit for partition, which would change the nature and character of the suit.
